```
fix: convert password-reset expiry to the correct unit so links last 24h

Reset links were expiring after roughly 1 hour instead of the configured
24 hours. The expiry window was configured in hours but stored as if it
were already in the unit the token store expects, so the stored value was
off by the conversion factor and the token aged out far too early.

Convert the configured 24-hour window to the correct unit before storing
it. No change to the configured value or to how the token store reads it,
so existing stored tokens are unaffected.
```
